content: Akhaan-nọng ọmaana atzọhmnọng pa Sọlọmọn
Iwa ọvaar Sọlọmọn ọdabh Israẹl biphyir.
Ma wọ iwa ode adenho p'akhaan-nọng pẹ:
Azariya kw'ode nnwa kwa Zadọk kw'ode ọfọhnẹja;
Ẹlihorẹph ọmaana Ahija p'ade va p'ijinọng pa Shisha, ade akkẹri; Jehoshaphat kw'ode nnwa kw'Ahilud, ode oye-idik;
Bẹnaya nnwa kwa Jẹhoyada, ode odenho kw'arim-egbong; Zadọk ọmaana Abiyata, ade afọhnẹja;
Azariya kw'ode nnwa kwa Natan, ode okkeri-adabhi pa ngọma; Zabud kw'ode nnwa kwa Natan, ode ọfọhnẹja ttara ọnọng kw'ọm-ọgbaak ọvaarnọng atzim;
Ahishar, ode ọphaar-idik s'ẹvaar-ttọhmma; Adoniram kw'ode nnwa kw'Abda, ode okker-itzọhm s'ini agbukha ipe.

Iwa Sọlọmọn ọkhaam adabhi-ngọma jobh obhiri afa, k'Israẹl biphyir, p'anangi ọvaarnọng ọmaana anọng p'awobh k'ọvaar-họhm ọchattọhk. Ọnọng kpenamkpen ọkhaam ophe wani ka cho kw'osi mphaari s'ọchattọhk mva ọnanang.
Ma wọ ode che pabẹ:
Bẹn-Hur ọdabhi mgbegbeho s'Ephraim;
Bẹn-Dẹkẹr ọdabh Makaz, ọmaana Shalbim, ọmaana Bẹt-Shẹmẹsh ttara Ẹlọn-Bẹtanan;
Bẹn-Hẹsẹd ọdabh Arubot (Soko ọmaana irek sa Hẹphẹr ide sẹ);
Bẹn-Abinadab ọdabh Naphot-Dor (wa kẹ ọtzọk Taphat kw'ode ominanwa kwa Sọlọmọn k'ọbada);
Baana kw'ode nnwa kw'Ahilud, ọdabh Taanak ọmaana Mẹgido, ttara ka Bẹt-Shan biphyir kw'ọbaang Zarẹtan, k'irekh-irek kwa Jẹzrẹl, ttẹwọr ka Bẹt-Shan maa, apyiri Abẹl-Mẹhola, ajekha achina ka Jọkmeam;
Bẹn-Gẹbẹr ọdabh Ramọt-Gilead (orukhabe fa Jair kw'ode Manasẹ ka Gilead ode fẹ, ọmaana ngọma s'Argọb ka Bashan, ttara idedenmon sẹ s'ikhaam abaakha arọbh attaan p'akhaam mbaakha-mma sa brons);
Ahinadab kw'ode nnwa kw'Ido, ọdabh Mahanayim;
Ahimaz ọdabh Naphtali (kẹ okk'Basemat kw'ode ominanwa kwa Sọlọmọn ọtzọkha k'ọbada);
Baana kw'ode nnwa kwa Hushayi, ọdabh Ashẹr ọmaana Alọt;
Jehoshaphat kw'ode nnwa kwa Parua ọdabh Isaaka;
Shimeyi kw'ode nnwa kw'Ẹla, ọdabh Bẹnjamin;
Gẹbẹr kw'ode nnwa kw'Uri ọdabh Gilead (k'obhon kwa Sihon kw'ode ọvaarnọng kw'ab'Amọr, ọmaana k'obhon kwa Og kw'ode ọvaarnọng kwa Bashan). Kẹ-kẹ wọ iwa ode ọdabhi kw'ẹkhọma nduma.
Ikkọ ọmaana ekkoji cha Sọlọmọn
Iwa anọng pa Juda ọmaana p'Israẹl ahaabhi mach'oyeyeng kw'ẹraanga-kha. Wa anọng mba achi, agwo ettem ebire ẹdaam bẹ.

Mando kwa Sọlọmọn ọdabhi ivaarbhon nna biphyir, ttẹwọr k'ọraanga kw'Euphrates, akwu apyiri k'irerek s'aPhilistiya maa, apyiri k'enem ch'Ijip. Wa ngọma nna mminchena Sọlọmọn nnduma, sẹ mbiri nwobha k'irekh-irek kwẹ, k'akpen pẹ biphyir.
Iwa ọchattọhk fa Sọlọmọn orori k'ewu ode akwakkama ẹrọbh obhiri jobh p'abubuma akkakka, ọmaana akwakkama arọbh attaan p'ọchattọhk.
Abhaam jobh pa bẹ anangi ọchattọhk k'ọpa, abhaam ẹrọbh pa bẹ anangi araraari, ọmaana arukhimaan arọbh azen ọmaana avu, akwu attara k'achimi, ọmaana njip, ọmaana ochimi-hora ttara inọhn s'ijibhi for.
Wa kẹ ọdabhi avaar p'idedenmon biphyir, k'okhubha kw'ewuchen em-edimi k'Ọraanga kw'Euphrates, ttẹwọr ka Tiphsa maa, apyiri Gaza obiro oruk k'odidiri k'okhubha kpenamkpen.
Israẹl ọmaana Juda, ttẹwọr ka Dan maa, apyiri Beershẹba arukhi k'odidiri, k'ogbe kwa Sọlọmọn. Ọnọng kpenamkpen ochi agrep ttara afig pa bẹ-bẹ ọkhaam.
Iwa Sọlọmọn ọkhaam obe fa bẹ am-ohok akpaar pa nnyanyaang mmindọr nnọhna jobh, obiro ọkhaama anyanyaang-pa nnọhna ẹrọbh obhiri jobh.
Adabhi pa ngọma, atzọk ọnọng-ọnọng k'ophe kwẹ, am-achena ọvaar Sọlọmọn ọchattọhk, ọmaana anọng biphyir p'am-achi ọttọhk k'okpokkoro kw'ọvaarnọng. Bẹ an-are bi, ọttọhk manda vani, bẹ kowori.
Bẹ abira atzima nnanga sabẹ sa abarli, ọmaana araraari-bukhi pa bẹ anang nnyanyaang sa mmindọr akpaar, ttara nnyanyaang ndọdọk, akwu ahok atzor k'obe fabẹ.
Ekkoji cha Sọlọmọn
Iwa Ibinọkpaabyi ọnang Sọlọmọn ekkoji ọmaana eronga ch'ideden, ttara etzina ch'ẹhaabhi mach'oyeyeng kw'ẹraanga-kha.
Ekkoji cha Sọlọmọn ẹbari ẹyọhnga ekkoji ch'anọng biphyir k'okhubha kw'ewuchen em-eyin, ebire ẹbar ọtzam ẹyọhnga ekkoji ch'Ijip biphyir.
Wa kẹ ọkhaam ekkoji ọyọhnga ọnọng kpenamkpen, attar Ẹtan kw'ofon Ẹzra. Ọkhaama ekkoji ọyọhnga Heman, ọmaana Kalkol, ọmaana Darda p'ade va p'ijinọng pa Mahol. Ọtza che k'idibhon idọdọk biphyir.
Ọgbaak adem nnọhna arọbh azenamfa obhiri arọbh jobh, obiro ọkkọhn amọng nnọhna mfa obhiri arọbh jobh obhiri azen.
Ọgbaak idik okhuri akpen p'araraari, ttẹwọr k'ichirọnọgbagba sa Lebanọn maa, apyiri ka hisop p'ameni k'echumi. Obiro ọgbaak idik s'ikhuri nden, ọmaana ọnọhn, jọhk ttara atzum, ọmaana nsitzen.
Avaarnọng p'ọyagbin p'akk'odik kw'ekkoji cha Sọlọmọn abhaanga, am-atzọhm anọng p'afon ka ngọma ndọdọk biphyir bi, bẹ akwu ayonga itzọhng anang ekkoji cha Sọlọmọn.
